description: Change a customer. Only the properties you pass change; identifiers, external_ids, fields and tags replace the stored set when given. Changing service_level_id moves the reply clocks of the customer's open conversations.

external_ids.description: IDs of the customer in other systems. Replaces the whole set when given.

source.description: Lowercase slug of the external system, such as hubspot or stripe.

fields.description: Values keyed by customer field key. Replaces the stored values when given.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

identifiers.description: Email addresses and domains of the customer. Replaces the whole set when given. One owned by another customer is refused, never moved.

service_level_id.description: A reply time from shipmail_list_service_levels, or null for the mailbox default.

tags.description: Free-form labels such as vip or churn risk. Replaces the whole list when given; trimmed, lowercased and deduplicated. At most 20 tags of 1 to 32 characters, without commas.

name: shipmail_update_customer

service_level_id.description: The reply time this customer gets. Null means the mailbox default.

tags.description: Free-form labels such as vip, stored lowercase. Empty when the customer has none.

title: Update Customer
